influences.name: Jeff Beck
influences.context: The last thing that I put into Moises was a Jeff Beck song.

influences.name: YES
influences.context: I'm currently going back to the music that I grew up with and using track separation to hear music I've loved on a whole different level. Things like "YES- And You and I" or parts of Dark Side of the Moon are blowing my mind once again after separating all the tracks!
